This removes the sound from your board. The audio file itself is not deleted and stays where it is on your device.

Soundboard NG is an offline soundboard for theater, live events, and other productions. Organize sounds in multiple boards; play, pause, restart, and loop tracks; adjust volume and fades; and back up or restore your configuration and audio files.

Soundboard NG is a modified fork of Soundboard by 508.dev. The original project and its contributors retain credit for their work. This fork adds extended playback controls, multiple boards, configurable fades, and backup and restore features. It is not an official release of 508.dev.
